h: Jaymie reportedly criticises Opeyemi over comments about Igbos, saying 'your tribe has failed this country'
p: Social media user Jaymie has reportedly hit back at Opeyemi over remarks about the Igbo people that she described as tribalistic. The exchange comes amid heated online debate about ethnicity and the 2027 elections.
more: The row follows other recent online arguments over tribe and voting.
Many users have called for calm in the debate.
